settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Adjust language, rendering, and quality options.
settings.cost_legend: LOW / MED / HIGH indicators represent performance impact. If you experience lag or frame drops, try disabling HIGH items first.

show_decor.label: Decor
show_decor.description: Draws the trees and vehicles scattered procedurally over the terrain. Anything you placed yourself stays either way.

show_structures.label: Buildings
show_structures.description: Toggles whether buildings are rendered on top of the terrain.

texture_pack.label: Textures
texture_pack.description: Applies detailed pixel-art textures to block and object surfaces instead of flat colors.

lock_camera_tilt.label: Camera Tilt Lock
lock_camera_tilt.description: Locks vertical camera rotation while horizontal rotation stays free.

lighting.section_caption: Effects that make shape and edges readable

show_edge_shade.label: Cube outlines
show_edge_shade.description: Darkens only edges that border open air, so flat ground stays seamless and height changes read as a line.

off.label: Off
off.description: Every surface gets the full ambient light.

corner.label: Corner (geometry)
corner.description: Darkens the floor along a cube and the inside of a corner, so blocks sit on the ground instead of floating over it. A few ops per pixel.

screen.label: Detailed (SSAO)
screen.description: Enhances depth by adding detailed contact shadows in crevices and corners. Recomputed over the whole screen, so it is the heaviest.

show_rim_light.label: Rim Light
show_rim_light.description: Adds a subtle highlight along object silhouettes to separate them from the background.

quality.section_caption: Adjust screen clarity and detail settings

disclaimer.demo_notice: This service is a demo, and data may disappear or it may be discontinued without notice.
disclaimer.coverage_notice: Currently, only regions in South Korea are supported; all other areas are displayed as ocean.
disclaimer.storage_notice: Objects you place are not saved to the server, and are stored only on this device.
disclaimer.location_notice: Your location data is neither collected nor saved.
disclaimer.character_notice: The CC0-licensed <kenney>Kenney</kenney> asset pack is applied to characters and decor.

about.tagline: Find a real place and stack blocks on it.

drawer_modal.title: Drawer
drawer_modal.description: Every placeable cube color and decor kind, plus your companion's appearance.

orientation.unsupported: This environment doesn't support the orientation sensor.
orientation.permission_error: An error occurred while requesting orientation sensor permission.

geolocation.unsupported: This environment doesn't support location services.
